name: Jest of the Echoing Cave
body:
School: Transmutation; Level: jester 6

CASTING

Casting Time: 1 swift action

EFFECT

Range: Personal

Target: You

Duration: 1 round

DESCRIPTION

You are blinded and gain blindsense out to a range of 15 feet until the end of your next turn.
